intended_object: The identity morphism on each object of the category `Pairwise ι`, the diagram category of pairwise intersections. Its objects are `single i` and `pair i j`, and its only non-identity morphisms are `pair i j ⟶ single i` and `pair i j ⟶ single j`. Inferred from the docstring and the module documentation.
explanation:
The definition works by cases on the object. It sends `single i` to the constructor `id_single i` and `pair i j` to the constructor `id_pair i j`. These are exactly the identity arrows of the inductive type `Hom`, so it gives the identity at every object.

It is then used as the `id` field of the `CategoryStruct` instance. The `Category` instance compiles, so the identity laws hold (`id ≫ f = f` and `f ≫ id = f`, with composition `comp`).

There is no question of generality: `ι` is an arbitrary type. This is the internal piece of the category structure that the docstring describes, and it is correct.
